run_split_dataset_programmatic: run the split_dataset script in programmatic mode to split assembly solutions into train, val, and test sets
run_split_dataset_interactive: run the split_dataset script in interactive mode with custom train problem IDs for dataset splitting
run_collect_casses: run collect_casses to gather all non-empty assembly solution names from problem directories in an asm directory
run_parse_args: run parse_args to build an argparse parser for asm-dir, mode, train IDs, and output path arguments
run_main: run main to split assembly dataset into train, val, test sets and pickle the result to a file
